verdict.rationale: AMD's own product page is a structured spec sheet rather than marketing copy. In this evidence, though, it shows only power (cTDP 45-120W) plus peripheral specs such as NVMe RAID, OS support and max displays. The memory figure (quad DDR5-8000) comes only from a community comment, not the vendor. Missing for 10: vendor-published clock speeds, memory support specs, AI TOPS figures, and test conditions for any performance claims.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can comparison-shop from a real spec sheet — the vendor publishes clocks, power, memory support, and AI TOPS with test conditions, instead of marketing adjectives
